defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: src/auth.py:16-17 — `!` is invalid Python negation; module raises SyntaxError on import (important)
src/auth.py:16-17 — `or` short-circuit skips password compare_digest, leaking timing info about username correctness (important)
src/auth.py:16-17 — double-negative logic harder to read; invert to positive form (nit)
votes.evidence_quote: `src/auth.py:16` — `!` is not a valid Python negation operator; Python uses `not`. The module `SyntaxError`s on import and never loads.
votes.justification: The review points to the if condition in src/auth.py and says `!` is not a Python negation operator. It also says this makes the module raise SyntaxError on import, which matches the known defect.
